author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದಿನನಿತ್ಯ ಕಾಯಕದೆ ಯಾಂತ್ರಿಕತೆ ಅಡರುತಿರೆ
ಸಿನಿಕತನ ತೋರದೆಯೆ ಚೈತನ್ಯ ತುಂಬು
ಮನ ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆ ನಿಷ್ಠೆಯೊಡೆ ಆನಂದ ಮೇಳವಿಸೆ
ಘನವೃದ್ಧಿ ಕಾಯಕದೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: don’t turn cynical; fill it with life;
when joy combines with sincerity and devotion of mind,
there is great growth in your work, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Routine can make work dull. Instead of turning cynical, bring energy, sincerity and joy to it, and it becomes a source of growth.
